page.notes: The left edge carries shadows and fragments of the neighbouring page; these are not transcribed. "siernente" is uncertain in the scan (probably "tendente"), so it is marked [?]. The bottom gathering mark "I 3" is read with some doubt. Printed spelling kept throughout, including "fua", "fi-mul" and "ipsis". The page number 173 is printed at top right.
